note: Both sets are drawn from the same wiring schedule rows (10, 20, 31–34, 50, 150, 151) and every claim in each is correctly bound to its row, with quotes that support the stated value. The two sets share 21 of 25 claims; Set A uniquely captures the 150 conduit size (2-1/2"C.) and ground-conductor sizes for items 31 and 33, while Set B uniquely captures conductor specs for 34, 50 and 150 plus the 32 conductor material. Neither set contains a misread, misbound or invented value, and each omits a comparable handful of schedule facts (A misses 34/50/150 conductor specs; B misses 150 conduit and the 31/33 grounds), so their overall accuracy and coverage are essentially equivalent.
